annotations.title: SEC filings index and latest filings feed (free)

description: Free, no payment needed. Two uses: (1) with a ticker, CIK or company name, a US public company's 10-K (annual), 10-Q (quarterly) and 8-K (material event) filings from SEC EDGAR, newest first, back to 2001; (2) with no company, the latest filings across all companies from EDGAR's live feed (about the last few business days): "Which companies reported earnings since Friday?", "Who announced a CEO change today?", "Which 10-Qs were filed this morning?". Each filing has the company, ticker, form, filing date (and acceptance time in the live feed), sec.gov link, the sections sec_filing_section can extract (Risk Factors, MD&A, Business, Legal Proceedings, Market Risk, Cybersecurity) and the event items of each 8-K (earnings 2.02, executive changes 5.02, deals 1.01, cybersecurity incidents 1.05, …). Filter by form, 8-K `items` (codes or words like "earnings") and date. Every filing carries `next_call`: the exact paid tool call, with arguments and price, that returns its text. Up to 50 filings per call. Rate-limited per client.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193. Use this, `ticker` or `company`.

company.description: Company name, e.g. "Apple" or "Coca-Cola". Use this, `ticker` or `cik`; a name matching several companies returns their tickers, free.

forms.description: Which filings to list: 10-K (annual), 10-Q (quarterly), 8-K (material events). Default: all three.

items.description: Only 8-Ks reporting any of these items, e.g. ["2.02"] for earnings, ["5.02"] for executive changes, ["1.05"] for cybersecurity incidents (words like "earnings" work too). Implies forms ["8-K"].

limit.description: How many filings to return, newest first (1-50, default 20).

since.description: Only filings filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Reaches back to 2001 for one company; the market-wide feed covers about the last few business days.

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK-B. Use this, `cik` or `company`; leave all three out for the latest filings of all companies.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).
